deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano's leading on-chain protocols
Documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified interface definitions
Agent-first documentation, protocol skills packaging operations, and an MCP server for protocol discovery and calls
Twelve additional protocol onboardings, three per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage
Use of Intersect treasury management smart contracts with milestone-based disbursement controls
request.recipient: TxPipe, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor
request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe to deliver an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols with developer and AI-agent-facing infrastructure over 12 months.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a common open-source interface for Cardano protocols, including documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposal says Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and rebuild understanding independently.
The proposer claims AI agents will become a major source of on-chain activity and require shared, auditable, deterministic protocol interfaces to reduce risks from hallucinated transactions.
Through Catalyst Fund 14, TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production with five protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.

The proposal commits to onboarding twelve additional protocols, three per quarter, with developer and agent coverage, and to developing the MCP server and skill framework as shared registry infrastructure.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.
The withdrawn funds would be administered through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts with external oversight from six named entities and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for TxPipe's Tx3 open API and agent infrastructure work, asserts ecosystem need and strategic alignment, provides governance-process and smart-contract administration details, and references external materials for voting, audits, and treasury management.
